name: Steam Download
author: David JM
description: Live Steam download progress in the Omarchy bar, read from the Steam client's own app manifests and staging directory.

barWidget.description: Shows in-flight Steam downloads straight from the Steam client's own files, so the percentage, throughput and time remaining are read from the real staging directory rather than a guessed total. The pill appears only while something is downloading. Click it for per-game detail, or open Steam itself.

schema.label: Poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-measure the download directory. The download rate is derived from the growth between two polls, so shorter intervals make the speed and ETA steadier at the cost of more disk reads.

schema.label: Show queued downloads
schema.description: Include games Steam has accepted but not started downloading. They are listed in the popup only, and never count as active downloads.
